title: Snowflake demo case: retail demand forecasting
summary: A national retailer unifies sales, inventory, and weather signals inside Snowflake to power a daily demand forecast that planners can trust.
serviceDescription: A Snowflake-powered service that turns store sales, inventory, and weather data into a trusted daily demand view for planning teams.
serviceValue: Planners can react faster to demand shifts, reduce stockouts, and make better inventory decisions without manual spreadsheet work.
serviceHighlights: Unified data access across retail operations
Faster planning and lower operational risk
scenario: The team wants a single, governed view of point-of-sale transactions, replenishment data, and weather risk so they can predict weekly demand by region and adjust inventory faster.
workflow: Ingest the source feeds into Snowflake using staged tables and secure data sharing.
Model the data into curated views for forecasting, promotions, and stock availability.
Query the curated views from SQL-based dashboards and alerting workflows.
Publish a simple forecast summary for planners and operations teams.
sampleSql:
SELECT region, SUM(units_sold) AS units_sold
FROM retail_forecast_view
WHERE forecast_date = CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY units_sold DESC;
cocoCliOverview: cocoCLI is a lightweight command-line companion for Snowflake-style workflows. It helps a team stage a demo case, validate the environment, and run a simple data workflow from the terminal without losing the narrative of the business use case.
whySnowflake: Elastic compute that scales with data volume and demand
SQL-first analytics that keep data teams productive
Secure sharing and governance for cross-functional collaboration
benefits: Faster decisions with a single source of truth
Less manual reporting and fewer spreadsheet handoffs
A clearer path from raw data to operational action
